parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the annotated data for task packages. The starting value is 1, and the default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of annotated data entries per page to display in a paged query. Default value is 20.

parameters.name: SubtaskId
parameters.description: The subtask ID. For information about how to obtain a subtask ID, see [ListSubtasks](~~454675~~).

parameters.name: TaskID
parameters.description: Task ID. For information about how to obtain a task ID, see [ListTasks](~~454662~~).

parameters.name: TenantId
parameters.description: Tenant ID. For information about how to obtain a tenant ID, see [ListTenants](~~454649~~).
